---
title: "A Complete Hooks File"
---

Hooks rarely live alone. A real `.claude/hooks/` directory mixes a safety block and a workflow gate. This capstone shows several primitives composing in one file, and which ones you can unit-test.

<!-- gd-embed: capstone.py -->

`block_command` is deterministic, so it ships with inline tests that run in CI. The `gate` fires on live session state, like which files were touched and whether the tests ran, so it carries no inline tests and you verify it by replaying a real session. One file listens on `PreToolUse` and `Stop` at once. See [Test hooks inline](../guide/testing.qmd) and [Enforce a multi-step workflow](../guide/workflows.qmd).
